title: JUDAS LONDON's "Regrets" is a musical work of art
htmlContent:
JUDAS LONDON's "Regrets" is a musical work of art that gives fresh life to finding new music to explore. Its that music you hit play on and get a refreshing experience that you can feel, with a sound that stands above the rest of the records you consume. If you’re looking for a record that does everything right as well gives great substance to hear this record is ready made for you to enjoy.
